model_equation: G(t) = G0 * (floor + (1 - floor) * exp(-max(0, t - grace_days) / tau_days)); t = consecutive days below maintenance dose; G = training-induced gain above untrained baseline (baseline never decays). Retraining: regain rate toward previous peak = normal gain rate * retraining_multiplier; normal rate above previous peak.

units.grace_days: days of consecutive below-maintenance activity before any decay
units.tau_days: exponential time constant (days) of decay toward floor after grace
units.pct_loss_by_week: percent of training-induced gain lost after N weeks of full inactivity; low = slow-decay scenario, mid = mid parameters, high = fast-decay scenario
units.retained_floor_frac: fraction of gain kept at long-term plateau
units.retraining_multiplier: multiplier on normal gain rate while below previous peak
units.age_modifiers: multipliers applied to tau_days (and retraining_multiplier where given) by age band
